legacy_compatibility: M81-DAPP identifiers are legacy compatibility keys and must not be rewritten.
multichain_rule: A dApp keeps one SIC-ID-DAPP. Chains, deployments and contracts are represented as relationships rather than duplicated dApps.
relationship_model: DAPP -> DEPLOYED_ON -> CHAIN -> HAS_DEPLOYMENT -> DEPLOYMENT -> USES_CONTRACT -> CONTRACT
evidence_policy: Use public and legitimately accessible sources.
Record provenance, conflicts, limitations and confidence.
Do not infer people, territories or wallet ownership without public verifiable evidence.
Do not create a new SIC-ID when the entity already has one.
